text:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert P0: runtime-gpu-oom on infer-prod-4 during heavy traffic. Trigger: CUDA OOMs in runtime. Auto-page sent to #incidents and oncall_jane. Link: https://internal/redwood/incidents/3276543210

oncall_jane: ack I'm on it, paging SREs and eng-ml.

alec: seeing repeated 'CUDA out of memory' from runtime v2.3.4 on node infer-prod-4. Logs pushed to /var/log/oom-traces/oom-3276543210.log.

meera: initial ask: how many pods affected and customer impact?

alec: 3 pods hit OOM, kube restarts triggered. Pod names: infer-prod-4-a,b,c. No node reboot.

support-anna: customer-impact: 3 customers reported 502s starting ~3276543188. Support tickets #4532 #4533 #4534. Not widespread yet.

alec: quick GPU mem snapshot (nvml) from infer-prod-4-a:
```
GPU0: total 40GiB, used 39.2GiB, free 0.8GiB
Process: runtime(pid=24122) rss=35.6GiB, kvcache=18.4GiB, model_tokens_cache=12.2GiB
Alloc spikes at 3276543170-3276543186 correlated with batch sizes 12-16
```

meera: mitigation plan (immediate): 1) roll default batch_size down from 8->2 on /generate route 2) enable kvcache_soft_eviction=0.85 to force earlier eviction 3) canary the changes on 1 pod in prod. Doable in ~2m.

eng-ml-raj: note: aggressive kvcache eviction will increase token recompute on long contexts and may raise latency. We should consider fallback to a smaller quantized model (redwood-q4) for the bursty route if latency becomes bad.

alec: applying canary now to infer-prod-4-a:
```bash
# patch config on pod infer-prod-4-a
kubectl exec -it infer-prod-4-a -- /bin/sh -c 'apply-config --route /generate --batch_size 2 --kvcache_soft_eviction 0.85'
```

alec: canary applied. Watching logs. No new OOMs on that pod for 45s so far. :thumbsup:

meera: roll to 50% of pods if stable for 2m, full roll if stable 10m.

support-anna: customers who saw 502s are on older SDK that may send larger batches by default. Reaching out to them with mitigations and temporary throttling advice.

meera: hypothesis tracking (live):
H1: KV cache fragmentation / high resident KV allocations causing OOM (owner: alec) - evidence: large kvcache numbers in nvml snapshot, repeated growth without proportional frees in logs.
H2: Client burst-batching producing transient large allocations exceeding per-GPU headroom (owner: eng-ml-raj) - evidence: request traces show many batched requests size 12-16 at OOM times.
H3: Memory leak in runtime path for tensor temp buffers when sequence length > 8k (owner: meera) - low confidence, need heap dumps.

alec: collecting per-process memmaps, nvml timelines, and runtime heap profiles. Uploading artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/3276543210/. Will attach link once uploads complete.

alec: sample runtime log around the event:
```
[3276543171] WARN memory: allocation failed for 1.2GiB temporary tensor, attempting GC
[3276543172] INFO kvcache: shard-3 evicted 0 entries (threshold not reached)
[3276543173] ERROR runtime: CUDA OOM allocating 1.2GiB
[3276543174] INFO runtime: restarting process after OOM
```

oncall_jane: good work. Owners assigned. alec -> H1 live investigation, raj -> H2 traffic repro + client-side mitigation. meera -> H3 heap dumps and follow-up.

alec: quick check after canary roll to 50% (2/4 pods): infer-prod-4-b shows drop in peak mem usage from 39.5->33.1GiB. No new OOMs in 3m on patched pods.

meera: status update: mitigation in effect, customer impact reduced. Incident state -> mitigated (live RCA ongoing).

support-anna: informing affected customers of workaround: downgrade batch size on client or use per-request max_batch=2. Sending templates.

eng-ml-raj: for RCA we should include: per-GPU fragmentation traces, kvcache allocator histograms, request-size distribution, timeline of pod restarts, and any recent model or runtime changes. I'll start collecting traces from tracing service.

alec: nvml dump (short):
```
Timestamp: 3276543180
GPU0 memmap: 0-2GiB reserved, 2-20GiB kvcache shards, 20-36GiB model + temp buffers, fragmentation holes ~0.6GiB at high addr ranges
```

meera: taking next steps: create an RCA ticket, link artifacts, schedule 30m post-mortem once full timeline is assembled. For now keep this thread for live notes.

incident-bot: Incident 3276543210 status update: mitigated -> ongoing RCA. Playbook link: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/gpu-oom.

oncall_jane: Thanks all — handing off to daytime oncall for continued monitoring. I'll update the ticket and handoff notes.

meera: final live note: consider adding kvcache fragmentation monitoring (per-shard free list size) as alertable metric.

alec: uploading heap profiles now. Will post link in ticket.

support-anna: keeping customer comms open. Will update if any new reports come in.

eng-ml-raj: capturing client traces for repro. If we can repro with batch=12 locally, we'll open a client SDK fix.

meera: thanks team. We'll converge on RCA doc and timeline tomorrow.
